title: Jacobson radical descends through an integral overring
statement: Let B be a semilocal ring with Jacobson radical m_B, let B' be a semilocal ring integral over B [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure], and let A be an intermediate ring B ⊆ A ⊆ B'. If the map Spec(B') to Spec(A) is surjective, then A is semilocal and its Jacobson radical m_A equals the radical of m_B A. Consequently, every element x of A that lies in the Jacobson radical of B' belongs to the radical of m_B A, so some power x^m belongs to m_B A.
